blocks.text: The Settings page allows you to view and manage Software as a Service (SaaS) tenants added in 3rd-Party App Governance and Advanced SSPM. You can also configure Slack and email notifications from this page.
The Settings page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a list of all the onboarded tenants along with details such as integration status, platform, enabled features, etc.
Manage the tenants and add outbound integrations that allow you to receive messages and notifications from outside 3rd-Party App Governance.

blocks.text: On the Settings page, you can view the following tabs:
On the SaaS Tenants tab, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for a SaaS tenant.
Filter the tenants by Status, Platform, or Enabled Features.
Export the tenants report to a CSV file.
View a list of all the onboarded tenants. For each tenant, you can see the following details:
Status: The integration status of the tenant. One of the following statuses displays:
Healthy: The integration is completed successfully.
Unhealthy: Failure to achieve a connection. Contact Zscaler Support if you require further assistance.

Onboarding: Connection is achieved and 3rd-Party App Governance is ingesting the relevant data. It might take a while to pull and ingest all relevant application data depending on the size of your tenant. During this time, a message displays indicating that the tenant is still being processed. You then receive an email from Zscaler when the tenant is ready for further review.
See image.
Platform: The platform on which the tenant is supported.
Name: The name of the tenant.
Enabled Features: The feature that is enabled for the tenant. It can be App Governance, SSPM Scan, or both.
Connected By: The person who added the tenant.
Connected At: The date and time the tenant was added.
Last Synced: The date and time the tenant was last synced. If the tenant has yet to sync, N/A displays. If the duration of the sync is excessive, the last sync time is highlighted in red.
Edit a tenant. To learn more, see Connecting Your Platforms to 3rd-Party App Governance and Connecting Your Platforms to Advanced SSPM.
Reconnect a tenant. To learn more, see Connecting Your Platforms to 3rd-Party App Governance.
Delete a tenant. To learn more, see Connecting Your Platforms to 3rd-Party App Governance.

blocks.text: On the Notifications tab, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Add Slack outbound integration.
Add email outbound integration.
